description: Original Salareen Khmer learning song with a public-domain Cambodian cultural listening reference.

records.title_target: ដំណើរផ្សងព្រេងភាសាខ្មែររបស់យើង
records.source_note: Optional cultural listening: a 1931 public-domain traditional Khmer recording. The instructional lyrics below are original Salareen lyrics, not a transcription.

verses.target: ជំរាបសួរ សុខសប្បាយទេ? រីករាយណាស់ជួបអ្នក
verses.roman: Chum reap suor, sok sabbai te? Rikreay nas chuob anak
verses.en: Hello, how are you? It is very nice to meet you.
verses.explain_en: This greeting verse joins a respectful hello, a friendly check-in, and “nice to meet you.” Use it when meeting someone new.
verses.tts_text: ជំរាបសួរ។ សុខសប្បាយទេ? រីករាយណាស់ជួបអ្នក។

verses.target: សូមទោស បន្ទប់ទឹកនៅឯណា? វានៅទីនោះ ខាងស្តាំ
verses.roman: Som tos, bantob tuek nov aena? Vea nov ti nuh, khang sdam
verses.en: Excuse me, where is the bathroom? It is over there, on the right.
verses.explain_en: Som tos politely gets attention. Nov aena asks “where?” Khang sdam means “on the right.”
verses.tts_text: សូមទោស។ បន្ទប់ទឹកនៅឯណា? វានៅទីនោះ។ ខាងស្តាំ។

verses.target: ម្ហូបនេះជាអ្វី? ឆ្ងាញ់ណាស់ សុំទឹកមួយ
verses.roman: Mhoob nih chea avei? Chhnganh nas, som teuk muoy
verses.en: What is this dish? It is very delicious. Water, please.
verses.explain_en: Mhoob means food or dish. Chhnganh nas is enthusiastic praise: “very delicious.”
verses.tts_text: ម្ហូបនេះជាអ្វី? ឆ្ងាញ់ណាស់។ សុំទឹកមួយ។

verses.target: មួយនេះតម្លៃប៉ុន្មាន? ថ្លៃពេក ថោកជាងនេះបានទេ?
verses.roman: Muoy nih tamlay ponman? Thlai pek. Thok cheang nih ban te?
verses.en: How much is this? Too expensive. Can it be cheaper?
verses.explain_en: This market verse moves from asking the price to polite bargaining. Keep a friendly tone.
verses.tts_text: មួយនេះតម្លៃប៉ុន្មាន? ថ្លៃពេក។ ថោកជាងនេះបានទេ?

verses.target: ខ្ញុំមិនយល់ទេ សូមនិយាយម្តងទៀត យឺតៗ
verses.roman: Khnyom min yol te. Som niyeay mdong tiet, yeut yeut
verses.en: I do not understand. Please say it again, slowly.
verses.explain_en: A powerful learner phrase: say you do not understand, then ask for one more slow repetition.
verses.tts_text: ខ្ញុំមិនយល់ទេ។ សូមនិយាយម្តងទៀត។ យឺតៗ។

verses.target: អរគុណច្រើន ជំរាបលា ជួបគ្នាពេលក្រោយ
verses.roman: Aw kohn chraen. Chum reap lear. Chuob knea pel kraoy
verses.en: Thank you very much. Goodbye. See you next time.
verses.explain_en: The final verse closes warmly and respectfully, with thanks and a promise to meet again.
verses.tts_text: អរគុណច្រើន។ ជំរាបលា។ ជួបគ្នាពេលក្រោយ។
